listen_port.description: Port on which c2s listens for client connections.

listen_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the listener to.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for client connections.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the server certificate file for TLS.

tls_key_file.description: Path to the server private key file for TLS (can be same as cert file).

tls_ca_file.description: Optional: Path to CA certificate bundle for client cert verification.

tls_verify_mode.description: Level of client certificate verification (none, request, require, optional).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before disconnecting a client.

auth_timeout.description: Seconds allowed for a client to complete authentication.

auth_backend.description: Authentication backend: 'local' for internal user DB, 'mysql' or 'ldap' for external.

mysql_pass.description: MySQL password for the user (use secure storage).

ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URI (e.g., ldap://host/ or ldaps://host/).

ldap_binddn.description: DN to bind as for user lookups.

ldap_bindpass.description: Password for bind DN (use secure storage).

ldap_basedn.description: Base DN to search for users.

ldap_scope.description: LDAP search scope: base, one, or sub.

ldap_filter.description: LDAP search filter; %u is replaced by the username.

quota_sessions_per_user.description: Maximum concurrent sessions allowed per user.

quota_messages_per_minute.description: Maximum number of messages a user can send per minute.

log_file.description: Path to the c2s log file.

rate_limit_rules.description: List of rate-limiting rules to apply to incoming stanzas.

max.description: Maximum number of stanzas allowed per interval.

acls.description: List of access control rules (e.g., block specific JIDs).

action.description: Whether to allow or deny matching traffic.

match.description: JID or pattern to match (supports wildcards like *).
